cost.detail: Local CPU only: two full ablation sweeps (62 + 80 sentences), four mutation clones, three preflight runs. No rental, no CI dispatch, no network fetch.

subagents._why: One item, one file at a time, and every mutation test needed the tree settled. A seat would have been a second writer for no parallelism.

what_i_got_wrong: I REPORTED A FABRICATED READING TO TRIMCRAE BEFORE CHECKING THE HARNESS, AND IT POINTED AT THE PAPER. The first sweep was launched with the SYSTEM python3, which has no pytest in this sandbox (dev-setup installs into the uv tool venv, deliberately, and says so). claim_ablation runs each witness with `sys.executable`, so all 22 pytest witness commands died on ModuleNotFoundError, _baseline_reds correctly subtracted them, and sentence after sentence came back BLIND. I sent 'two blind in the first four' upstream with a caveat, then found the cause. The caveat is not the lesson — the harness control (`can this produce a red at all?`) is written into that module's own docstring as the thing to run FIRST, and I ran it second.

AND MY FIRST CULPRIT FOR THE STALE CENSUS WAS THE OBVIOUS ONE AND WAS WRONG. I expected a prose edit without a regeneration; `git log` on the two paths showed the article and the census artifact were last written by the SAME commit. The real cause was a guard-pattern widening three commits later, in a different directory from the artifact it staled — which is why AUT-PD-130 is a real defect and not a reminder to be careful.

cycle_id_alias.where: the owner written on AUT-PD-105's lease, pushed to the trunk at d18f8dc
cycle_id_alias.why: The claim is taken in step 4 and the receipt id is allocated in step 10, and two sibling cycles landed receipts in between, so ids.next_receipt answered 0069 where the lease had said 0067. The ordinal is 'the Nth cycle' and the discriminator is what keeps two cycles from sharing a file, so this is the allocator behaving as designed. Recorded rather than silently reconciled: a reader following the lease from git history lands on 0067 and must be able to find this receipt.
